en.bdb: Great is His greatness, as great as His Name.
en.ms: Great is Lord's glory, as great is His Name.

pu.ss: ਉਸ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੀ ਸਿਫ਼ਤਿ ਕੀਤੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਜਾ ਸਕਦੀ ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਨਾਮਣਾ ਵੱਡਾ ਹੈ ।

en.bdb: Great is His greatness, as True is His justice.
en.ms: Great is His glory, as true is His justice.

pu.ss: ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਾ ਇਹ ਇਕ ਵੱਡਾ ਗੁਣ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਉਸ ਦਾ ਨਾਉਂ (ਸਦਾ) ਅਟੱਲ ਹੈ ।

en.bdb: Great is His greatness, as permanent as His Throne.
en.ms: Great is His glory, as, stable is His seat.

pu.ss: ਉਸ ਦੀ ਇਹ ਇਕ ਵੱਡੀ ਸਿਫ਼ਤ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਉਸ ਦਾ ਆਸਣ ਅਡੋਲ ਹੈ ।

en.bdb: Great is His greatness, as He knows our utterances.
en.ms: Great is His glory, as he knows our utterances.

pu.ss: ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੀ ਇਹ ਇਕ ਬੜੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਉਹ ਸਾਰੇ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਦੀਆਂ ਅਰਦਾਸਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਹ

en.bdb: Great is His greatness, as He understands all our affections.
en.ms: Great is His glory, as He understands all our affections.

pu.ss: ਸਾਰਿਆਂ ਦੇ ਦਿਲਾਂ ਦੇ ਵਲਵਲਿਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਮਝਦਾ ਹੈ ।

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਜਾ ਪੁਛਿ ਨ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
verses.translit_en: vaddee vaddiaaiee jaa puchh na dhaat ||

en.bdb: Great is His greatness, as He gives without being asked.
en.ms: Great is His glory, as He gives gifts without being asked for.

pu.ss: ਰੱਬ ਦੀ ਇਹ ਇਕ ਉੱਚੀ ਸਿਫ਼ਤ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਕਿਸੇ ਦੀ ਸਲਾਹ ਲੈ ਕੇ (ਜੀਵਾਂ ਨੂੰ) ਦਾਤਾਂ ਨਹੀਂ ਦੇ ਰਿਹਾ (ਆਪਣੇ ਆਪ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਦਾਤਾਂ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ਦਾ ਹੈ)

en.bdb: Great is His greatness, as He Himself is all-in-all.
en.ms: Great is His glory, as He Himself is all in all.

pu.ss: (ਕਿਉਂਕਿ) ਉਸ ਵਰਗਾ ਹੋਰ ਕੋਈ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੈ ।

en.bdb: O Nanak, His actions cannot be described.
en.ms: Nanak, His acts cannot be narrated.

pu.ss: ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਰੱਬ ਦੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਬਿਆਨ ਨਹੀਂ ਕੀਤੀ ਜਾ ਸਕਦੀ,

en.bdb: Whatever He has done, or will do, is all by His Own Will. ||2||
en.ms: What He did or shall do, is all His own will.

pu.ss: ਸਾਰੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਉਸ ਆਪਣੇ ਹੁਕਮ ਵਿਚ ਰਚੀ ਹੈ ।੨।
